newsitem.title: UK: Stakis says can add to Metropole margins.
newsitem.headline: Stakis says can add to Metropole margins.

text.p: Stakis Plc chief executive David Michels said the company can add to margins at its Metrpole hotels acquisition.
He told Reuters Financial Televison that Metropole, being bought from Lonrho Plc, was "extremely well-managed", especially for conferences and exhibitions and the like.
"It is less interested in leisure breaks, in particular corporate and overseas individual visitors. We think we can add all three and margins will follow," Michels said.
Asked if hotels and casinos group Stakis was looking for further buys, Michels said, "Not at all."
He said Stakis was "not after size" and said it would concentrate on developing its existing businesses and plans for new casinos.
